identificationModule.briefTitle: A Frontline Therapy Trial in Participants With Advanced Classical Hodgkin Lymphoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Open-label, Phase 3 Trial of A+AVD Versus ABVD as Frontline Therapy in Patients With Advanced Classical Hodgkin Lymphoma

armGroups.label: A + AVD
armGroups.description: A+AVD consists of brentuximab vedotin (ADCETRIS®) 1.2 milligram per kilogram (mg/kg) plus doxorubicin 25 milligram per square meter (mg/m\^2), vinblastine 6 mg/m\^2, and dacarbazine (DTIC) 375 mg/m\^2.

armGroups.label: ABVD
armGroups.description: ABVD consists of doxorubicin 25 mg/m\^2, bleomycin 10 units per square meter (units/m\^2), vinblastine 6 mg/m\^2, and dacarbazine (DTIC) 375 mg/m\^2.

interventions.name: brentuximab vedotin
interventions.description: Brentuximab vedotin (ADCETRIS®)1.2 mg/kg by IV infusion on Days 1 and 15 of each 28-day cycle.

interventions.name: doxorubicin
interventions.description: Doxorubicin: 25 mg/m\^2 by IV infusion on Days 1 and 15 of each 28-day cycle.

interventions.name: bleomycin
interventions.description: Bleomycin: 10 units/m\^2 by IV infusion on Days 1 and 15 of each 28-day cycle.

interventions.name: vinblastine
interventions.description: Vinblastine: 6 mg/m2 will be administered by IV infusion on Days 1 and 15 of each 28-day cycle

interventions.name: dacarbazine
interventions.description: Dacarbazine (DTIC): 375 mg/m\^2 by IV infusion on Days 1 and 15 of each 28-day cycle.
